So i will recommend max 8.0 Recommended range all V2 models: -2.0 to 8.0 (some times 10.0) V1: I understand why noone has made this before now. This felt almost impossible to make, for multiple reasons. But i have managed to make a pretty good and somewhat stable LoRA. You can see from the samples, that all use 2 different seeds, since there was no need to "cherry pick" sample images from multiple seeds. It should work with most, if not all checkpoints and LoRAs that make penises to begin with. There is some things to keep in mind, that i dont think is possible to fix. Prompting always helps a lot, so a combination of this LoRA and prompting is best. I have not been able to test it with all checkpoints and LoRAs, but the ones i have tested works from very good (Moody V10) to ok-ish (BigLove 3) .
